title: VCSL Keys: Grand Piano, K
author: Versilian Studios (sampled for VSCO 2 Pro)
instrument: a Kawai grand piano: VCSL names it "Grand Piano, K", Versilian's library list "Grand Piano, Kawai"; model and size are not given
capture: a stereo pair in player position ("Player" in every file name), 44.1 kHz/16-bit stereo FLAC
pitch_names: the library names middle C (MIDI 60) C3, an octave under the scientific pitch used here; ids carry MIDI numbers, as the SFZ's pitch_keycenter gives them, except the takes it names A#-1 and centres on A#0 (22), which sound A0 (21): see RECORDED_PITCH in Tools/decode_vcsl.py
velocity_layers: up to four per pitch, by the SFZ's lovel/hivel (0-54, 55-83, 84-106, 107-127 where all four play); a layer is numbered from the softest the pitch has
mixing: the SFZ (amp_veltrack 88) raises each region by its own volume opcode: the recordings keep their dynamics, about 33 dB from the softest layer to the loudest at the median
releases: rel<midi>: the release take the SFZ plays when that key is let go at velocity 80; from F6 up, the undamped keys, the SFZ maps none, so those keys carry the nearest lower pitch's (carried_from)
decoding: ffmpeg to PCM16 WAV, no gain, trim, resampling, denoising or EQ
